routes_max2.definition: Replace self-owned cage walls/ribs within actual ray-limited torso volume; preserve complete shoulder seats/waist annulus and every actual complete-function protected stock. Use broad interconnected material around cavities; existing 4mm rails are not permanent design minima.

Use front/rear lateral load shells around actual complete packs and low pump zone, joined by wide top/waist load transfer roots. Compare under identical protected interfaces/function stocks; do not assume this route fits before full CSG+assembly-sweep evaluation.

FEM_boundary_input_plan.cage_only_FE: Apply downstream-arm six-dimensional shoulder resultants instead of those same arm body gravity; distribute own cage/system gravity once on actual mesh/interfaces. Reaction wrench at actual waist port is the negative total force/moment translated to waist datum.
FEM_boundary_input_plan.6D_transform: M_new = M_old + (p_old - p_new) cross F; axes/origins must be explicit. Recompute changed source masses/COM before transport.
FEM_boundary_input_plan.free_body_gauge: Integral rigid-motion constraints only remove six null modes; gauge rows may not absorb a non-balanced load. Check sumF/sumM before solve.
FEM_boundary_input_plan.assembly_mount_model: Waist pressure/compression and finite bolt/seat compliance, shoulder preload and contact remain unknown. Never fully fix waist plus both shoulders to create artificial stiffness.
